entries.name: dft_energy_water
entries.description: B3LYP/def2-SVP single-point energy for water — minimal DFT template.
entries.notes: Plain DFT energy. Adapt by replacing the geometry block and tuning xc/basis.

entries.name: dft_optimize_water
entries.description: B3LYP/def2-SVP geometry optimization for water — driver block with tight convergence.
entries.notes: Uses noautosym to avoid symmetry-related restart issues. tight convergence is the safe default.

entries.name: dft_frequency_water
entries.description: B3LYP/def2-SVP geometry opt followed by analytical frequencies for water.
entries.notes: Frequencies pick up the converged geometry from the preceding optimize task. Real workflows usually want a separate freq job to checkpoint independently.

entries.name: tce_ccsd_t_water
entries.description: CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVTZ single point for water using the Tensor Contraction Engine.
entries.notes: Explicit `freeze N` (N=1 here for H2O core). Never use `freeze atomic` per project rule. Memory budget is generous; lower if running on a workstation.

entries.name: dft_open_shell_fe_water
entries.description: Fe(II) high-spin (quintet, S=2) DFT single-point template with explicit mult/odft.
entries.notes: Always pair open-shell DFT with frontier orbital + spin density analysis to verify the SOMOs sit on Fe-d. Run analyze_nwchem_frontier_orbitals after this.

entries.name: mcscf_o2_triplet
entries.description: O2 triplet ground state CAS(8,6) — classic 2p sigma/sigma*/pi* active space.
entries.notes: ROHF triplet guess feeds the MCSCF orbital optimization. Adapt the active window for larger systems by re-counting electrons + orbitals.

entries.name: tddft_formaldehyde
entries.description: Formaldehyde n->pi* lowest singlet excitation via TDDFT in the TDA approximation.
entries.notes: TDA (CIS) is the default here; replace `cis` with `rpa` for full TDDFT. nroots=5 gets the first five singlets.

entries.name: dft_cosmo_water_in_water
entries.description: B3LYP energy with COSMO solvent model (epsilon = 78.4, water). Sanity-check template for solvent setup.
entries.notes: Switch dielec to match your solvent. After the run, check COSMO surface charge convergence in the output.
